FROM SURFACES TO PARTICLES

Make room to experiment.

Import models, shape their particles, and save complete looks with DialKit.

  • Models: GLB is recommended. For glTF, include its .bin and image files. OBJ supports geometry without external materials.
  • Layers: enable up to four layers. Each has its own shape, color, pattern and sprite. Select a layer, then use the Sprite / atlas section.
  • Interaction: choose particle flow or mixed flow to carry and grow particles briefly before they return.
  • Lighting & finish: light controls face visibility and size. Bloom, exposure, vignette and grain finish the image.
  • Camera: use feedback and zoom reveal, or orbit manually. Scroll can control the morph or the reveal.
  • Presets: name a look and choose Save preset. Switch versions in the Presets menu. Edits stay with the selected version. Import / Export transfers the controls and sprites as JSON.

Presets and sprites stay in this browser. Model files are separate and need to be loaded again after a refresh. Models are centered and normalized. Initial pose only; animation clips and KTX2 are not supported. Up to 6 models and 100 MB per import. Lighting uses face normals without cast shadows.
